messages:
From: Erin Lowe <erin@fathomai.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — FathomAI (PO / spend cap details)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick onboarding help earlier. Attached is our completed vendor onboarding form and the bank details (PDF). We have two distinct billing streams for Redwood usage:
- Core license (monthly/annual)
- Usage overages (dynamic, metered monthly)

Is it possible to receive separate PO numbers for those two streams so we can map charges correctly in our AR system? We also need a provisional spend cap for the first two months while we ramp (anticipated $40k/month, with burst allowance up to $60k if usage spikes).

Also: the SKU descriptions on your sample PO template use internal codes; would you accept updated SKU descriptions to match our catalog (we'll send a short mapping).

Attachments: [Attachment: FathomAI_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: Bank_Details_Redacted.pdf (application/pdf)]

Best,
Erin Lowe
Head of Finance Ops
FathomAI
erin@fathomai.com
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: erin@fathomai.com
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — FathomAI (PO / spend cap details)

Laura / Ben / Mina —

Looping you in to request provisional PO assignment and spend-cap guidance for FathomAI. They specifically want: two PO numbers (one for core license, one for metered usage) and an initial spend cap that can be increased if we see demand. Summary below:
- Account: FathomAI (vendor)
- Requested initial spend cap: $40,000/month, burst allowance to $60,000/month (approval required)
- PO split: PO-A for Core License (recurring line), PO-B for Usage (metered)
- SKU naming: vendor will provide mapping to replace our internal SKU shortcodes with their descriptions

Could procurement provision provisional PO numbers and confirm the spend cap gating process? If we need Finance sign-off for the burst allowance, please call that out and I'll escalate. I'm attaching the quick PO allocation sheet I used with another vendor — fill the lines and return.

Attachments: [Attachment: po_allocation_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Vendor Onboarding / Procurement Coordinator
Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — FathomAI (PO / spend cap details)

Priyom —

Thanks. Drafted provisional PO references below after a quick ledger check. I put the initial spend cap on PO-B (usage) with a conditional burst clause that requires Finance notification at >75% monthly utilization. Please review and confirm before I lock these into the procurement system.

Draft PO assignments (provisional):
- PO-2027-FA-001 — FathomAI Core License — $24,000 monthly (recurring) — Line 1
- PO-2027-FA-002 — FathomAI Metered Usage — initial cap $40,000/month, burst up to $60,000/month pending Finance sign-off — Line 2

Line item notes:
1) We currently have SKU shortcodes in our ERP (RF-SUB-LIC, RF-OVERAGE). Vendor requests human-readable descriptions (e.g., "FathomAI Compute - Metered Tokens"). If vendor provides mapping, we'll update the PO line descriptions to match.
2) If FathomAI needs split invoicing by customer code, we can add a secondary reference field.

I've attached the CSV export from the PO system showing the provisional references. These are not yet committed — I'll hold until we get final confirmation from Erin.

Attachments: [Attachment: PO_assignments_20270402.csv (text/csv)]

Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — FathomAI (PO / spend cap details)

Hi Laura / Priyom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the provisional PO numbers — that helps a lot. We accept PO-2027-FA-001 / PO-2027-FA-002 as provisional references. One small request on the PO line descriptions: please change the usage line item description to read exactly "FathomAI Compute - Token Consumption (metered)" instead of the placeholder. That label is required for our AR reconciliation.

I've attached a short SKU mapping sheet and I'm happy to sign any commitments once line descriptions are updated. Also confirm whether Redwood will issue separate invoices per PO or a single combined invoice with PO reference lines (we prefer separate invoices per PO for easier application).

Thanks — Erin
Erin Lowe
Head of Finance Ops, FathomAI

Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Finalize PO serials and line item descriptions — FathomAI

Laura / Ben / Mina —

Per Erin's confirmation, please implement the following final changes and commit the POs in the system by end of day Monday:
- PO-2027-FA-001: FathomAI Core License — Line description unchanged
- PO-2027-FA-002: FathomAI Compute - Token Consumption (metered) — update line description exactly as vendor requested
- Invoicing: Finance prefers separate invoices per PO; please set the billing policy to issue separate invoices tied to PO line IDs
- Spend cap: Lock initial cap at $40,000/month on PO-2027-FA-002, with a conditional burst to $60,000 subject to Finance notification at 75% utilization. Finance (cc Ben) to approve burst before it is allowed.

Ben — can you confirm by EOD that Finance will accept the conditional burst and that a notification workflow exists? If not, flag here and I'll escalate to Ops.

Once procurement finalizes, please attach the final PO pack (signed DocuSign links) back into the vendor record and notify the vendor. I've included the DocuSign placeholder below in case you need it.

Related links / next steps: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765 (vendor record), DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/signed/FATHOM-PO-2764

Attachments: [Attachment: final_po_pack.zip (application/zip) — contains signed PO PDFs and vendor checklist stub]

Thanks — Priyom
